summary: Frontend-only regression for iOS BottomSheet fix (BottomSheetScrollView + enableDynamicSizing=false). Tested on web preview at 390x844 viewport. Onboarding, Explore Map/List toggle, List sections, pin tap → preview, close, and View full details all work end-to-end with no crashes or page errors. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: web preview uses /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/explore.web.tsx which does NOT use @gorhom/bottom-sheet at all (it renders a plain View 'sheet' area). The user's actual fix lives in the native file /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/explore.tsx. So this run validates JS component logic (PinPreview, ExploreListView, view toggle state, selection state, navigation) but cannot itself prove the gorhom v5 iOS rendering fix. Recommend a physical Expo Go smoke test on iPhone.

critical_code_review_comments: explore.tsx correctly imports BottomSheetView + BottomSheetScrollView from @gorhom/bottom-sheet and sets enableDynamicSizing={false}. The sheet header is inside BottomSheetView and each view mode wraps children in BottomSheetScrollView — this matches the documented v5 iOS workaround.
explore.web.tsx uses a plain flex View as the 'sheet' — no bottom-sheet library involved on web. Tests here validate PinPreview/ExploreListView JS logic only, not the native sheet rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding via testIDs onboard-name-input/onboard-mobile-input/onboard-location-input/profession-chip-investor/onboard-continue-btn lands on /explore. Web preview shows a fallback pin cloud (₹72 L, ₹45 L, ₹1.85 Cr, ₹35 L, ₹85 L, etc.). Pin tap sets selection state → PinPreview renders inline within the 'sheet' area (not a real gorhom sheet on web). Note that /explore route may bounce to /onboarding on hard reload if AsyncStorage user record is missing.
rca_of_issue: User reported iOS: bottom sheet header + pin preview not appearing. Root cause is a known @gorhom/bottom-sheet v5 behavior on iOS where nesting a plain ScrollView as a child of BottomSheet, combined with default enableDynamicSizing=true, causes the sheet content (including the handle/header) to fail to render/measure — the sheet collapses off-screen. Fix applied by main agent: wrap header in BottomSheetView, wrap scrollable children in BottomSheetScrollView, and explicitly set enableDynamicSizing={false} so the snapPoints are respected. Verified end-to-end JS logic for view toggle, pin selection, close, and navigation on web preview; the fix pattern matches the documented workaround, so it should resolve the iPhone issue. Final validation must be done on a native build / Expo Go on iOS.
